landing.whoContent: I‘m just a random guy that loves to code. I work mostly as frontend developer, but I love building stuff in Go too. My main knowledge:

0.title: eTopocart
0.description: Joined eTopocart in September 2025 as System Development Assistant

1.title: Technologist in IT Management
1.description: Graduated from Faculdade de Tecnologia e Inovação SENAC DF

minecraftTools.name: Minecraft Tools
minecraftTools.description: A bunch of tools for everyday Minecraft play: seed map, enchanting and villager trading guides, banner, shield and firework generators, calculators and more. Everything runs in the browser.

vndl.name: vndl
vndl.description: A video/audio downloader for YouTube, Twitter/X, TikTok and Instagram. Paste a link, pick a quality and download. It also converts images and videos right in the browser. Nothing is stored on the server.

mcManager.name: mc-manager
mcManager.description: A self-hosted web panel so my friends and I can manage a Minecraft server without shell access: start and stop, live console, mods, modpacks, players, backups, charts and auto-sleep when nobody is online.

ultimateTrainer.name: Payday 2 Ultimate Trainer 7
ultimateTrainer.description: A mod for PAYDAY 2 with a collection of cheats and tools, controlled from an overlay inside the game or from any browser, even on your phone. Based on Ultimate Trainer 6 by Pierre Josselin.

siteBlocker.name: Simple Site Blocker
siteBlocker.description: A browser extension to block distracting websites with domain, wildcard and regex rules.

paragraphs.p1: Born and raised in Brasília, still live here.
paragraphs.p2: When I was around 8, my mom gave me a modded PlayStation 2. Besides playing a lot of random games, I wanted to know how that thing worked, and nobody around me could explain it.
paragraphs.p3: Some time later she bought us a computer with 512MB of RAM or something like that. I filled it with viruses trying to download mods and mess with software. That’s where it all started, and I never stopped.
